applies_why: The judge text resolves the chain-against-chain collision by asking whether any single text states the contrary in its own words, which is the verse-by-verse stating-verse test K-C retires.
quote: the passive egennēthē states no verdict on the begetter in either direction
rule_words: the collision weighs chain against chain by footing, never verse by verse; that no one of them states the contrary in its own words is the stating-verse test DG-61 retires, at a judge's seat as at a debater's, for either side.
why: The judge treats the absence of a single verse stating the contrary as decisive, so it applies the retired stating-verse test instead of weighing chain against chain by footing.
